verdicts.note: Night shot of a modern shopping-centre atrium: a lamassu-style elephant capital on a column, palm trees, Pepsi billboard.
Reconstructed brick theatre at Babylon: tiered seating rows and an arcaded stage building with a blue glazed-brick frieze.

verdicts.file: Drawing, Stage Design, Hall in a Babylonian Palace for the Opera "Ciro in Babylonia" by Gioacchino Rossini, 1818–19 (CH 18359655).jpg
verdicts.note: 1818 engraved stage design: imaginary columned hall with statues, an opera set, not the theatre ruins.

verdicts.file: The ancient history of the Egyptians, Carthaginians, Assyrians, Babylonians, Medes and Persians, Grecians and Macedonians. Translated from the French. 11th ed., rev., corr. and illus. with a set of (14781501544).jpg
verdicts.note: Antique engraved map of Assyria, Babylonia and Persia; a map of the region, no theatre shown.
Aerial view of the ruins of Palmyra in Syria with its colonnaded street and temple; a different site.

verdicts.file: Verdi - Nabucco - The temple scene (La Scala revival of 1913) - The Victrola book of the opera.jpg
verdicts.note: Black-and-white photo of an opera stage set with painted temple flats, columns and steps; a theatre scene, not ruins.

verdicts.file: Encyclopedia of antiquities - and elements of archaeology, classical and mediæval (1843) (14576831427).jpg
verdicts.note: 19th-century wood engraving of a thatched cottage/church among trees; unrelated to the Babylonian theatre.

verdicts.file: The lake of Tiberias, looking towards Hermon. David Roberts. 1855.jpg
verdicts.note: Lithograph of the Sea of Galilee shore with a walled town and Mount Hermon; a different place entirely.
